payload.independence_basis: Adaptyv Bio 是执行湿实验的机构，报告并非转述第三方新闻；但它参与同一项 Anthropic 合作实验，不能计作独立复现。
payload.quote: Overall, Claude designed proteins that bound 14 out of 15 targets, with 1 target (GDF-8 mature) being excluded due to low-quality measurements in our setup, likely due to the target aggregating, meaning it was binding to other molecules of itself.
payload.reason: 检测实验室自身发布了与 Anthropic 所述 14/15 相符的实验结果；这支持该合作实验的结果记录，但不证明后续完整表征已经完成。
payload.statement: Adaptyv Bio 直接报告在 15 个可评估靶标中有 14 个获得结合剂；另一个选定靶标 GDF-8 mature 因测量质量不足未纳入分析。
